title: Project 2 · Group tasks by status
prompt: The tracker now stores tasks with an ID, title, status and optional owner. Write countByStatus(tasks: TrackerTask[]): Map<TaskStatus, number>. Count how many tasks have each status. Include only statuses that appear, in first-seen order. An empty list gives an empty Map. Do not change the input.
hints: Start with an empty Map and visit each task once.
Read the current count for a status, defaulting to zero.
Store the count plus one under that status.
checks: (() => { const list: TrackerTask[] = [{id:"a",title:"A",status:"open"}]; countByStatus(list); return list.length === 1 && list[0].status === "open"; })()
feedback: Each status needs a running count. Check an empty list and a status that repeats.
